basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) CS & ECE Graduate Assistantship (RA/TA)
basic_details.offering_entity: Siebel School of Computing and Data Science, The Grainger College of Engineering, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC, USA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Thomas M. Siebel Center for Computer Science, Urbana-Champaign, Illinois, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) and research M.S. in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence & NLP, Systems & Cloud Computing, Computer Architecture, Programming Languages & Formal Methods, Security & Privacy, Database & Information Systems, Bioinformatics, High-Performance Computing, and Electrical & Computer Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial packages (~75 to 95 new fully funded PhD students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science and engineering compete annually (typically 3 to 6 admitted with full funding/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of guaranteed PhD funding (full tuition waiver, 12-month living stipend, and health insurance) subject to satisfactory academic progress

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants from all nations worldwide
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) or Master's degree (18 years education) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics with minimum 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA (3.80+ competitive from recognized Pakistani universities like LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, QAU).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.20/4.00 required by Graduate College; 3.75+ recommended for competitive PhD assistantship consideration.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced preparation in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems, operating systems, linear algebra, and data structures.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before August intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Peer-reviewed research publications, major open-source projects, and technical internships significantly enhance the application.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 103 (speaking 24+ for TA waiver) or IELTS Academic min 7.5 (speaking 8.0+ for TA waiver). Lower scores require English placement testing upon arrival.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite doctoral researchers in Computer Science and Data Science.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowships can be combined with departmental top-up funding.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided (base graduate tuition and engineering tuition differential ~$36,000/year waived completely; student pays only minimal student fee).

admission_application_fee.details: UIUC Graduate College international application fee ($90) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Paid out of living stipend; on-campus university housing or private apartments in Urbana/Champaign (~$600 to $950/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Full 12-month living stipend: academic year (9-month) RA/TA salary of ~$28,000 to $34,000 PLUS guaranteed summer research support (~$7,000 to $9,000). Total living support is ~$35,000 to $42,000 / year (~$2,900 to $3,500 / month; ~PKR 800,000 to 975,000 / month).

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Illinois are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa application fee ($185) and SEVIS I-901 fee ($350) paid to US Department of State.

health_insurance.details: Graduate assistant health, dental, and vision insurance plan provides comprehensive medical coverage (university covers ~85-90% of the premium; student pays minimal co-pay; ~$3,200/year value).

food_allowance.details: Meals and personal expenses covered by monthly stipend (~$300 to $450/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Thomas M. Siebel Center provides modern computing facilities, GPU clusters, and NCSA supercomputing resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental conference travel grants and faculty research grants cover travel and lodging for presenting at top conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Champaign-Urbana Mass Transit District (MTD) bus system is completely free for all UIUC students with valid student ID.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign - Top 5 CS in USA, QS World Rank #69)
participating_institutions: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Siebel School of Computing and Data Science, Grainger College of Engineering)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: US News #5 in Computer Science globally, #4 in Engineering; birthplace of the modern web browser (Mosaic) and PayPal co-founders.
available_majors: Programming Languages, Formal Methods and Software Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.): 5 years; Master of Science (M.S. Thesis): 2 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with 3.5+ GPA, strong research accomplishments, Statement of Purpose, 3 reference letters, and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: 100% of admitted PhD students receive full 5-year funding; admission is highly selective (~5% acceptance rate).
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Faculty review is decentralized. In your Statement of Purpose, identify 2-3 specific UIUC CS faculty members whose research labs align with your trajectory and cite their recent papers.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UIUC Graduate College Online Application Portal (Slate)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UIUC Slate admissions portal, select 'Computer Science - PhD', and upload required documents before the December 15 deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore research areas and faculty profiles in the Siebel School of Computing and Data Science.
Step 2: Create an account on the UIUC Graduate College Slate application portal.
Step 3: Upload unofficial transcripts from all colleges and universities attended.
Step 4: Upload your Statement of Purpose (highlighting research accomplishments and faculty fit).
Step 5: Provide contact details for 3 academic referees who will submit letters online.
Step 6: Upload your CV and any published research papers or preprints.
Step 7: Submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores (institutional code 1836).
Step 8: Pay the $90 application fee and submit before December 15.
Step 9: Faculty admissions committee conducts comprehensive reviews and interviews in January/February.
Step 10: Receive official offer letter (with 5-year full funding package) in February/March; accept by April 15.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: 100% integrated: admission to the CS PhD program carries the full 5-year fellowship and assistantship package automatically.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three confidential reference letters submitted online by referees.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: Describe your technical background, research goals, why you chose UIUC CS, and specific faculty you wish to work with.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into Statement of Purpose; outline research questions, methods, and topics of interest.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, software projects, awards, and technical skill proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Short technical/research interview (20-30 minutes via Zoom) conducted by interested faculty members prior to formal admission offers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General is NOT required and NOT reviewed for CS PhD. TOEFL iBT (103+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (7.5+ recommended).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Scanned unofficial transcripts uploaded at application; official HEC-attested transcripts and degree certificates required upon enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure name format matches educational documents.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of all university degrees showing courses, credits, and grades.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan attested documents.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page essay detailing research background, specific research questions, and faculty alignment.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mention specific UIUC CS professors and recent lab publications.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, software projects, and awards.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight papers published in Scopus/WoS or IEEE/ACM venues.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential letters from research mentors or senior professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees should submit from official university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (103+) or IELTS Academic (7.5+) report sent to institution code 1836.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure test score is valid at commencement.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 December (Strict PhD deadline for Fall admission)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: One annual intake cycle closing on 15 December for admission in the subsequent Fall semester.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and performance in core CS/math coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Track record of independent research, publications, and technical innovation)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity, depth, and originality of Statement of Purpose)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Strong, credible endorsements from established research mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Decisive during advisor review for candidate ranking
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Threshold requirement (TOEFL/IELTS compliance; GRE not used)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UIUC CS Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic, research-oriented evaluation. The committee selects candidates demonstrating both high intellectual rigor and genuine research creativity. Admitted PhD students receive guaranteed 5-year funding through departmental fellowships, RAs, or TAs.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,800 to 3,500 elite international applicants compete for UIUC CS PhD seats
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~75 to 95 fully funded PhD offers made annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 4% (Achievable for top graduates from LUMS, NUST, FAST with published research)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.85+ / 4.00 CGPA (85%+ aggregate) with at least 1 published conference paper or preprint
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of leading institutions with substantial research contributions in machine learning, systems, or architecture, and strong recommendation letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Applied Mathematics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: USA, China, India, Pakistan, South Korea, Iran, Taiwan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies claiming they can guarantee admission to UIUC CS. Admissions decisions are made solely by UIUC faculty committees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UIUC application fee is $90. Never pay external agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents. Writing your own Statement of Purpose is essential for conveying your research vision.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa fee ($185) and SEVIS fee ($350).
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Chicago O'Hare (ORD) plus bus to Urbana-Champaign (Peoria Charter ~$35 - $45).
Initial apartment security deposit (~$600 - $900) prior to first stipend deposit.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE scores are required. (FACT: UIUC CS does NOT require and does NOT accept GRE scores).
CLAIM: You must secure funding separately after admission. (FACT: All admitted PhD students receive a 5-year full funding guarantee automatically).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend rates; current UIUC CS RA/TA stipends range from $35,000 to $42,000/year including summer support.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 in all graduate coursework to remain in good standing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and teaching residency on the Urbana-Champaign campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews evaluated by the dissertation committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Under US F-1 visa regulations, paid employment is restricted to 20 hours/week on campus during semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. F-1 STEM graduates are eligible for 36 months of Optional Practical Training (OPT) in the United States post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; scholars fulfill standard graduate research or teaching assistantship duties (20 hours/week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; no clawback of past disbursed stipend or tuition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the Graduate Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions beyond Year 5 are supported through faculty research grants.
